name: Grave Marshal
title: The Unburied Commander

name: Ossuary Engine
title: The Hospital That Walks

name: The Last Witness
title: The World Inside the Wound
subject: A monumental fully armored robotic colossus kneeling, made entirely of solid weathered ivory ceramic armor, dark steel and gold machine cables. Broad layered chest armor with small recessed amber reactor. Enormous armored hands with five long separated mechanical fingers planted widely apart. Head is an elaborate assembly of three concentric blank ceramic masks opening around a dark circular camera aperture. Gigantic hunched silhouette, ancient machine deity, ornamental layered shoulder plates and knee armor. No human skin, no organic anatomy, no bare body, no pedestal. Entire figure and fingers visible.
sound: World sized cosmic colossus: subterranean pressure rumble, city collapse impact, nested inhuman wordless voices, colossal abyssal roar with resonant tail
